caption:
Solar can cut your Hawaiian Electric bill a lot. It can't take it to zero. Here's why. Sources on the last slide.

Follow for more plain-English Oʻahu solar math.

#Oahu #HawaiiSolar #SolarPower #HawaiianElectric #Honolulu

slides.text: Solar won't “eliminate your HECO bill.” Here's what's left.

slides.label: a month: the minimum on Hawaiian Electric's standard Oʻahu residential rate, even if you use zero power.

slides.text: Add panels, the bill drops. Then it hits a floor.

chart.note: Illustrative shape. Floor: Schedule R 1-phase minimum, $30.22 effective (Nov 2026).

slides.text: So any solar past that ~$30 floor just piles up credits.
And credits you bank but don't use get erased at the end of each year.
slides.sub: Every 12 months from your agreement start, HECO reconciles. Leftover banked credits are then set to zero.

items: Hawaiian Electric effective rate summary, Nov 2026: Schedule R 1-phase minimum charge $25.00 base, $30.22 effective.

Hawaiian Electric Rule 32, Export Rider (Sheets 49.40-I, J, K): credits may only reduce the bill to the minimum charge; reconciliation every 12 months from the Interconnection Agreement start; remaining banked kWh credits are set to zero.
